name: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Hotgen Biotech Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of medical and public safety inspection products of in-vitro diagnostic products in the field of biomedicine. It offers nucleic acid drugs, antibody drugs, and biotechnology health and beauty consumer products. The company also provides clinical diagnostics and product solutions, including Upconversion light, chemiluminescence, sugar capture, microfluidics, and genetic testing for testing of intestinal microorganisms, gastrointestinal foodborne infections, insect-borne diseases, respiratory pathogens, infectious diseases, Ebola virus antigen, biological warfare agents, microorganisms, and mycotoxins.…
